meta.name: sub0kelvin
meta.author: Hell Inc & Haznobrain
meta.description:
Far, far away from serpulo's sun, we have located a severe anomaly.

    In the absence of a divine body to regulate our world, a thermal anomaly has popped up. 
    A single planet in the outskirts of its system. Initial scans expected a total of 1 joule of thermal energy in the entire object.

    Later scans revealed that while the surface was still below what should be absolute 0, it possesses a warm and ressource rich core.

    Land on it.
    Survive the frost.
    Exploit the core.
